caveats: public display is permitted for every entry, but 82 of 92 corpus images require attribution and 62 require share-alike

held-out images may be shown in a demo but must not be used to justify a threshold
self-captured imagery remains preferable for the final live demo: it is the deployment domain and carries no attribution obligation
